output.name: cartnudge
output.tagline: Shopify upsells driven by what's in the cart — no popups, +9.4% AOV
output.description: cartnudge boosts AOV with native in-cart and post-purchase upsells on Shopify, using basket contents and store history. No popups, no theme edits. Average +9.4% AOV across 60 stores. Flat $19/month, no revenue share.
output.first_comment: We built cartnudge because Shopify merchants are stuck between popup spam and expensive revenue-share upsell apps. Our solution inserts offers directly into the cart — no interruptions, no theme changes. Offers are generated from your own order data, so they're relevant. In 60 pilot stores, we saw an average +9.4% AOV lift. It installs in one click and costs a flat $19/month — no per-order fees, no revenue share. We're early (Shopify-only, no A/B testing yet), but our App Store reviews are 5.0 stars so far. Would love feedback on pricing, offer relevance, and what integrations you'd want next.
